name: Hẹn hò dưới sao
notes: Two chibi sweethearts on a starry night (KayKit Adventurers, CC0: the Knight without his helmet and the Rogue, weapons dropped by scripts/pack-models.mjs). Stop 1: they walk in from both sides, he waves, she cheers, a note with the card's first words (slot note1) pops up. Stop 2: a picnic blanket unrolls, they sit down together under a shooting star and the card's photo rises in a glow with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: they stand, hug and kiss, hearts burst and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises among fireworks. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
